mapper.select: SELECT b.block_id AS blockId, b.step_id AS stepId FROM block b WHERE b.block_id = #{blockId} AND b.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT i.issue_id AS issueId, i.step_id AS stepId, i.title AS title, i.content AS content, CASE i.status WHEN 'TO_DO' THEN 'TODO' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.priority AS priority, i.due_date AS dueDate, i.finish_day AS completedAt FROM issue i WHERE i.step_id = #{stepId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM issue_block ib WHERE ib.issue_id = i.issue_id AND ib.block_id = #{blockId} )
ORDER BY i.issue_id DESC
